overview.short: Chakkulathukavu Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the goddess Durga.
overview.description: Chakkulathukavu Temple is a Hindu temple dedicated to the goddess Durga. Situated near Thiruvalla in Neerattupuram, Thalavady Panchayat, Alappuzha District, Kerala, India, it is one of the most renowned temples in the state. As one of the most popular deities in the region, Durga attracts pilgrims from all over South India. Initially, the temple was little-known, serving only as a family temple of a local resident, until it underwent renovation a few decades ago.

faq.q: What is the best time to visit Chakkulathukavu Temple?
faq.a: The best time to visit Chakkulathukavu Temple is Nov – Feb. Summers are 26–36°C and winters are 22–32°C.

faq.a: The nearest airport is Chakkulathukavu Temple / nearest airport (30 km) and the nearest railway station is Ernakulam Junction (Kochi) (72 km). Roads are generally good; check seasonal/monsoon conditions before high-altitude or remote stretches.
